evals.name: chart-by-session-id
evals.expected_output: The planted session's chart and U01's unit page are built into the toy plugin's workspace by the run-flow trace scripts, the user gets the URL and the path in two lines, and nothing is judged, edited or committed
expectations: transcript.md shows the trace built by one command of the form `python3 <plugin root>/skills/run-flow/scripts/trace.py build 0a0d17f0-0000-4000-8000-00000000fixt --plugin toy --out <workspace>` with AUDIT_RUN_PROJECTS set, where <workspace> is `$TMP/toy/runs/toy-project/ship the-toy-file/0a0d17f0/` (written absolute, or relative to `$TMP/toy` as the working directory) (the plugin directory, then runs/, the project's directory name, `<command> <title>`, then the first 8 characters of the session id) — not a path under the repo and not `$TMP/ws`

outputs/flow.html exists and wraps the U01 box in a link whose href is `units/U01.html`, and has an `

Units

` section with one row for U01 naming type toy:writer

outputs/units/U01.html exists, links back to `../flow.html`, and has `<h2>` sections Prompt, Steps, Commits and Returned in that order; its header block names toy:writer, spawner driver at D3 and 5 tool calls, 1 error, 1 hook block; its Steps section has eight step blocks anchored S1 through S8 in order; the step for `python3 -m pytest -q` shows the full output `...F` / `1 failed, 3 passed in 0.12s` (not clipped); the Write step for out/a.txt shows its content `a`; the hook block `toy guard: writer may not write .env` is shown; Commits lists abc1234 marked unconfirmed; Returned holds the whole three-line return beginning `Done. Wrote out/a.txt and committed it.`

outputs/units/U01.json exists with `unit` U01, `type` toy:writer, `step_count` 8, a `steps` array whose `step` ids are exactly U01.S1 through U01.S8 in order, a Write step (U01.S2) whose `write.content` is `a\n` whole, a Bash step (U01.S4) whose `output` contains `1 failed, 3 passed` with `error` true, and a `return` beginning `Done.`; outputs/index.json's U01 entry carries `json` = `units/U01.json` and `step_count` 8

outputs/chat.md holds the closing message as two lines: the first names the run (toy 0.1.0, the command `/toy:ship out/a.txt`, 1 unit, its wave count) and gives a URL of the form `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/flow.html` plus the path to flow.html; the second says each box opens the agent's page and that audit-run is how a run is judged

Nothing judges the run: neither outputs/chat.md nor outputs/units/U01.html says whether the writer followed its definition — no finding, verdict, WARN or compliance remark about its `tests: 4 passed` claim, its unconfirmed commit or its write to notes/scratch.md (the page shows those facts and stops; trace.py's own labels, such as `unconfirmed` on the commit and `error` on a failed call, are facts from the trace, not judgments); the workspace has no `findings/` directory and no `report.md`

transcript.md shows nothing edited or committed: no `git commit`, `git add`, `git checkout -b` or `git push`; no Write or Edit to any file under the repo, under `$TMP/toy` outside `runs/` and `.gitignore`, or under the transcripts; and, since $TMP/toy is not a git checkout, no .gitignore was written there (outputs/toy.gitignore is absent or empty) and transcript.md says the ignore line was skipped for that reason

transcript.md shows that no `http.server` was left running — the server's pid was killed before the final message, or it was never started and outputs/chat.md says so — and outputs/interview.md either does not exist or holds no question about which chat: the id resolved on its own

evals.name: title-words-and-fork-question
evals.prompt: What did the writer agent do in the "Ship the toy file" chat? Show me the run.
evals.expected_output: The chat title resolves through trace.py to two matching sessions, the user is asked once and picks the original, and the same chart and unit page as a typed run are built and served from the toy plugin's workspace with nothing judged
expectations: transcript.md shows the session resolved from the title, not guessed: the first `skills/run-flow/scripts/trace.py build` (or `find`) call that names a session (a `--help` probe does not count) carries words from the title `Ship the toy file` as the session argument, with `--plugin toy` and AUDIT_RUN_PROJECTS set, and the full session id appears in a trace.py command only after the user's answer

outputs/interview.md records exactly one question about which chat, with at most four options, each labelled by the chat's title in quotes, the fork's description saying `fork of 0a0d17f0`, and the answer taken being the original session beginning `0a0d17f0`, not the fork beginning `f0a0d17f`

transcript.md shows the workspace as `$TMP/toy/runs/toy-project/ship the-toy-file/0a0d17f0/` (not `f0a0d17f`, not under the repo), built by `trace.py build <session> --plugin toy --out <that workspace>`

outputs/flow.html exists and wraps the U01 box in a link whose href is `units/U01.html`; outputs/units/U01.html exists with `<h2>` sections Prompt, Steps, Commits and Returned, eight step blocks S1 through S8, the Write step for notes/scratch.md and the pytest step's full output `1 failed, 3 passed in 0.12s`; outputs/units/U01.json has `step_count` 8 and a `prompt` of `Target: out/a.txt`

outputs/chat.md holds the closing message as two lines: the run (toy 0.1.0, `/toy:ship out/a.txt`, 1 unit) with a URL of the form `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/flow.html` and the path to flow.html; then that each box opens the agent's page and audit-run is how a run is judged — and it answers the question by pointing at the writer's page (U01), not by retelling the steps as a judgment

Nothing judges the writer: outputs/chat.md and outputs/units/U01.html carry no finding, verdict or compliance remark about the writer's `tests: 4 passed` claim, its unconfirmed commit abc1234 or its write outside out/; trace.py's own labels, such as `unconfirmed` on the commit, are facts from the trace and allowed; the workspace has no `findings/` directory and no `report.md`

transcript.md shows no `git commit`, `git add`, branch or push, no Write or Edit under the repo or to the transcripts, and that no `http.server` was left running (killed before the final message, or never started and said so)

evals.name: writer-across-two-sessions
evals.expected_output: One trace.py view command builds both sessions' workspaces and a cross-session page listing the four writer runs in time order, each linked to its unit page, and the user gets that page's URL and path in two lines with nothing judged
expectations: transcript.md shows the build done by one command of the form `python3 <plugin root>/skills/run-flow/scripts/trace.py view --plugin toy --agent writer --root $TMP/toy/runs --sessions 0a0d17f0-0000-4000-8000-00000000fixt,0f10d17f` with AUDIT_RUN_PROJECTS set — not two separate `trace.py build` calls stitched by hand — and no positional session was asked for: outputs/interview.md does not exist or holds no question about which chat
outputs/runs/views/ holds exactly one file, named `writer-<YYYY-MM-DD>.html` with today's local date, whose header names both sessions (0a0d17f0 and 0f10d17f)

that view page's table has the column headers Session, Unit, Mode, Section, Round, Start, Duration, Tool calls, Errors, Files written, Commits, Returned in that order, and exactly four rows, in time order: 0a0d17f0 U01, then 0f10d17f U01, U02, U04 — no reviewer row (0f10d17f's U03 and U05 are absent)

on that page every Unit cell links to `../<project>/<run>/<id8>/units/U<nn>.html` (the run folder URL-encoded) and each target file exists under outputs/runs/ (outputs/runs/toy-project/ship the-toy-file/0a0d17f0/units/U01.html, outputs/runs/toy-project/ship/0f10d17f/units/U01.html, U02.html, U04.html); every Session cell links to that session's flow.html; Mode is `—` on every row; the first row's Returned cell is `Done. Wrote out/a.txt and committed it.` and the other three read `Result: done`

both workspaces are complete: outputs/runs/toy-project/ship the-toy-file/0a0d17f0/ and outputs/runs/toy-project/ship/0f10d17f/ each hold index.json, flow.html and units/U*.html, and outputs/runs/toy-project/ship/0f10d17f/agents/writer.html exists with three rows (U01, U02, U04) and agents/reviewer.html with two; every unit in outputs/runs/toy-project/ship/0f10d17f/index.json carries a `mode` key

outputs/chat.md holds the closing message as two lines: the first names the agent type writer, the four runs across the two sessions, and a URL of the form `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/views/writer-<date>.html` served from runs/ plus the page's path; the second says each row opens that run's own page (its unit page, the agent's record) and audit-run is how a run is judged

Nothing judges the runs: outputs/chat.md and the view page carry no finding, verdict or compliance remark about any writer (not about 0a0d17f0 U01's `tests: 4 passed` claim or unconfirmed commit); no `findings/` directory and no `report.md` anywhere under outputs/runs/

transcript.md shows no `git commit`, `git add`, branch or push, no Write or Edit under the repo, under `$TMP/toy` outside `runs/` and `.gitignore`, or to the transcripts, and that no `http.server` was left running (killed before the final message, or never started and said so)
